svg.text: Self-Service Coffee Kiosk System — UML Component Diagram
Architecture: Layered (Presentation → Business Logic → Data) · Prathith Shetty · SRN PES2UG24AM121
Coffee Kiosk Software (runs on the kiosk PC)
touch events · menu, size & pay screens
in-process API calls: getMenu(), addItem(type, size), checkout()
database queries (SQL): getMenuItems(), getPrice(type, size), saveOrder(order)
Order flow (data flow through the layers)
Customer taps a coffee type (Espresso / Americano / Latte) and a size (Small / Large).
Order Manager reads the menu and price from the Menu & Pricing Database.
Customer pays by credit card: Payment Service reads the card and asks the bank to approve.
On approval the order is saved and the Receipt Printer prints the receipt.
• Menu: 3 coffee types × 2 sizes, each with a price (editable by staff)
• Completed orders: order id, items, total, time, payment approval code
• No card numbers or PINs — card data never leaves the Payment Service
